anomalyMagnitude.explanation: grossWeightChange magnitude (100,000,000,001.02 g) is 42,372,881,356x larger than netWeightChange (2.36 g) on the same record. Net weight must always be <= gross weight for a physical jewellery item (net = gross - stone/other weight), so a ratio this large is structurally impossible, not just unusual. For scale: 100,000,000,001.02 g is roughly 1.25e+10x the gross weight of a typical gold ring (~8 g, e.g. Jitendra's "gold rings" item at 50.76 g total for 16 units). This is corrupted/anomalous data, not a real weight -- classified ANOMALY, do not migrate.
